### 🟢 Approval recommended The change is narrowly scoped to uniform-block padding, is applied consistently to both declarations, and directly addresses the confirmed WebGL2 UBO size validation error.
Pull request overview Fixes a WebGL2-only rendering failure caused by a std140 uniform block size mismatch for `DirectionalLightData` in the GLES3 scene shader, which could lead to draws being rejected due to an undersized UBO. **Changes:** - Replace the trailing `mediump vec3 pad;` in `DirectionalLightData` with three `mediump float` padding members to ensure std140 size closes at 384 bytes. - Apply the same layout adjustment to both directional-light uniform block declarations within `scene.glsl` (vertex/fragment sections).
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | drivers/gles3/shaders/scene.glsl | Adjusts `DirectionalLightData` std140 padding so the shader-side uniform block size matches the 384-byte C++ UBO layout on WebGL2. |
Review details - **Files reviewed:** 1/1 changed files - **Comments generated:** 0 - **Review effort level:** Lite
